head: ḏ̣yr 2 (< Arab. ḍrr (IV) cf. Wehr 745: schaden, Schaden zufügen;)

examples.turoyo: moṣele i=ʕaskar d-nošo lo=mqaru laf-elayye w-maḏ̣ər-re b-mede
examples.translation: he commanded the army not to near them and not to damage them anything
examples.raw: moṣele i=ʕaskar d-nošo lo=mqaru laf-elayye w-maḏ̣ər-re b-mede ‘he commanded the army not to near them and not to damage them anything’; 36/105;

examples.translation: er schadet sich, (weil er zuviel raucht)
examples.raw: k-maḏ̣ər ruḥe ʻer schadet sich, (weil er zuviel raucht)ʼ; 545;

examples.translation: Smoking caused me a lot of harm.
examples.raw:
Li ǧǝġara ġalabe maḏǝrlali.
 Smoking caused me a lot of harm. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Lǝ gṭoreno noše d maḏǝr lu Sargey.
examples.translation: I will not anybody to cause harm to Sergey.
examples.raw: Lǝ gṭoreno noše d maḏǝr lu Sargey. I will not anybody to cause harm to Sergey. (İlyas p.c)

notes: farq: soyəm farq (cf. Kurd. ferq kirin, Omar 1992 204: unterscheiden, auseinander halten, bemerken; cf. Tur. fark etmek, Steuerwald 292: unterscheiden, auseinander halten, trennen; (be-)merken;) see frq
